links.comparator_used: Human review of LLM output without disagreement triggering (M1 and M2 modes, where humans judge each sample)
links.outcome: Human intervention rate (manual workload) while keeping accuracy
links.effect: M3 markedly reduced intervention rates; accuracy under M2 and M3 ranged from 0.633 to 0.900 (no per-mode intervention numbers in the abstract)
links.tradeoff: Disagreement Trigger Mode was cost-effective for structured and moderate-reasoning tasks, but Reasoning Support Mode was more stable and practical for open-ended and highly subjective tasks.
links.quote: M1 showed relatively limited performance in both accuracy and intervention rate; M2 achieved the highest accuracy in most tasks; M3 markedly reduced intervention rates.

links.comparator_used: Human review in modes not triggered by disagreement between the two LLMs (M1 and M2)
links.outcome: Human intervention rate and assessment efficiency when disagreement between DeepSeek V3 and Qwen-plus triggers human review
links.effect: M3 markedly reduced intervention rates; accuracy under M2 and M3 ranged from 0.633 to 0.900
links.tradeoff: Less stable for open-ended, highly subjective tasks, where Reasoning Support Mode was more stable and practical.
links.quote: Disagreement Trigger Mode exhibited high cost-effectiveness in structured and moderate-reasoning tasks, enhancing assessment efficiency, while Reasoning Support Mode was more stable and practical for open-ended and highly subjective tasks.

links.comparator_used: Evidence Extraction Mode (M1): LLM-extracted evidence only, without reasoning explanations
links.outcome: Accuracy and consistency of human risk-of-bias judgments
links.effect: M2 (evidence plus reasoning) achieved the highest accuracy in most tasks, whereas M1 showed relatively limited accuracy; incorporating LLM reasoning improved consistency in human judgments
links.quote: Incorporating LLM reasoning improved consistency in human judgments.

design_hint: human-AI collaboration modes and disagreement-triggered human review
